column1: # The Debian and Ubuntu releases packages are built for: one apt suite each, named by its codename.
# The CI workflow (.github/workflows/packages.yml) makes its build matrix from this table, and
# packaging/docker.sh runs the same builds locally.
#   id: target name; image: official container; codename: apt suite; suffix: Debian revision suffix
#   (the same version is built once per suite, and the pool needs distinct file names; "~" keeps a
#   distribution upgrade an upgrade); camera: whether sp9-libcamera is built (needs PipeWire 1.6)
